verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's instance overview documents per-second billing for actual usage, which covers the granularity part of the story directly. The billing reference describes stopped instances as detached from their GPUs, which implies GPU charges stop, but it never states that billing halts or what still accrues (e.g. storage) while stopped. missing for 10: explicit documentation that charges stop (or which charges continue) when an instance is stopped, independent or hands-on corroboration of per-second billing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
